title: 0px Spacing in Notification popups
line: In the notification history, a notification's image no longer touches the action buttons below it.
explanation: The notification delegates are laid out in a GridLayout with zero row spacing by design. The popup delegate gives its image extra margins, so popups show a small gap, but the history delegates (single and grouped) do not, so the image's bottom edge sat directly on the action buttons' row. The change gives the image in both history delegates a small bottom margin (Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing) whenever the footer with the buttons is shown.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: add spacing between image and buttons in history

In the notification history the image touched the action buttons below
it, because the delegate grid has no row spacing and only the popup adds
a margin. Give the image the same small bottom margin when buttons follow.

BUG: 509275

patches.diff:
From 4bea014b32bcb0cc6dd0eacdb2734c55382f7cfc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:12:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: add spacing between image and buttons
 in history

In the notification history the image touched the action buttons below
it, because the delegate grid has no row spacing and only the popup adds
a margin. Give the image the same small bottom margin when buttons follow.

BUG: 509275
---
 applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistory.qml        | 3 +++
 applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml | 1 +
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistory.qml b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistory.qml
index 7b772c5207..78815d31c7 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistory.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistory.qml
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+
 import "../components" as Components
 
 
@@ -36,6 +38,7 @@ BaseDelegate {
 
     Components.Icon {
         id: icon
+        Layout.bottomMargin: footerLoader.visible ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
         Layout.row: 1
         Layout.column: 1
         Layout.rowSpan: 2
diff --git a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml
index 2df7c366ab..3fe90f77ce 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml
@@ -75,6 +75,7 @@ BaseDelegate {
 
     Components.Icon {
         id: icon
+        Layout.bottomMargin: footerLoader.visible ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
         Layout.row: 1
         Layout.column: 2
         modelInterface: delegateRoot.modelInterface
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: History, single notification: the image touches the View button (0 px)
History, single notification: 4 px gap between image and View button
History, grouped notifications: both images touch their View buttons
History, grouped notifications: 4 px gap for both

review.text: Adding Layout.bottomMargin on Components.Icon fixes the 0px gap when the image is taller than the text, as shown in the screenshots, but the fix is both incomplete and placed on the wrong layout item. As acknowledged in the notes, it leaves the reporter's second screenshot case (a job notification link touching the Open with button) unfixed while still closing the bug with BUG: 509275, and it also fails whenever body text is taller than the icon or no icon is present.
changes: Add top spacing on footerLoader (or the footer/delegate layout in DelegateHistory.qml and DelegateHistoryGrouped.qml, checking DelegatePopup.qml and JobItem as well so spacing is consistent and not doubled) rather than only adding Layout.bottomMargin to Components.Icon, so action and job buttons always have a gap below both icons and body text/links.
Verify and cover the reporter's job notification case (link above the Open/Open with button) as well as text-only and tall-body notifications with action buttons.
